harness.identity_basis: host developer metadata; no runtime switch or comparative performance inference

objective: Derive causal electron response and evaluate the direct-ejection sub-10 eV Coulomb stopping contribution for the already source-pinned CR-PHYS01 scenario.
motivation: Quantify which part of terminal secondary heating can actually have reached a fixed cold gas after a finite source turn-on, without replacing cosmic rays with photon or ad hoc heat sources.
mode: bounded research convergence with lightweight numerical verification
closure: Classical superthermal leading-log Coulomb-only continuous slowing down in a prescribed homogeneous electron bath; Khrapak2020 Eq6 cutoff and FS10 Eq5 stopping coefficient. Reaching 0.1eV transfers residual kinetic energy to an explicitly unresolved cutoff reservoir, not to heat.
source_time_dependence: Leading local expansion Np(K,t)=t qp(K); therefore Qe(W,t)=t A(W), not a constant electron source. Exact inherited Bianchi characteristic source coefficients are sampled solely to quantify this new approximation; original PHYS01 source is not overwritten.
approximations: leading order in H*t and shear*t for the newly evaluated local response
continuous mean stopping instead of full electron Fokker-Planck energy diffusion
classical Coulomb-log cutoff at leading logarithmic order; upper window near classical/quantum crossover
fixed gas, no self-consistent temperature or ionization feedback
no magnetic field and no electron-neutral energy transfer in selected closure
all stopping energy is deposited in the prescribed electron bath; gas equilibration is not solved
invariants: primary binding cost distinct from ejected electron kinetic energy
causal response vanishes for negative age and zero elapsed time
injected selected electron energy = deposited stopping energy + tracked electron kinetic energy + cutoff residual
no heat allocation for unmodelled electron or proton tails
separate instantaneous power and cumulative deposited energy
no reuse of one-point terminal REI packet for delayed receiver

acceptance_fixed_before_numerics.negative_and_domain_tests: explicitly reject nonfinite/negative/unsupported input; zero time and source OFF return exact zero
acceptance_fixed_before_numerics.decision: independent decision reviewer not involved in candidate generation

claim_ceiling: Derived and numerically checked conditional subthreshold stopping component. Not a full secondary cascade, certified physical uncertainty, thermal equilibration, causal IGM history or revised production receiver.
original_atomic_gates: PRESERVED; b_grid NO_GO, physical production gates unchanged
authorization: Current request for next bass_cr physics loop plus existing repo push and create-only Drive/Dropbox backup approval; no main merge or external messaging
publication_plan: New additive research branch from fixed PHYS01 parent; ordinary R1 remote identity check; create-only two-provider backup.
